services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: Arrangements will be made with the Charter Captain leading up to the fishing charter. Meet times and locations will be discussed upon booking. Items included with the fishing charter package include all needed fishing poles, tackle, and bait. Ice and bottle waters are provided and guest may use this cooler to store personal snacks and beverages. Fuel for the boat is also included at no additional cost. For Pass Christian fishing charters, all anglers will be covered under the Captain's charter fishing license and no licenses will be needed. For charter trips from Pass Christian to the Louisiana Marsh, a $20 Louisiana 3 Day Charter Fishing License must be purchased by clients 16 years of age
